constraints: Keyword indexes (indexType = -1) cannot be composite: fieldsArray must contain exactly one field.
Composite indexes require two or more fields in fieldsArray, and the order of the fields in the array matters for how the index is built.
If an index named indexName already exists, the command does nothing.
With '*' passed, indexing runs asynchronously: the calling method continues immediately, regardless of whether indexing has finished.
Locked records encountered during indexing are skipped until unlocked; the command waits for them.

overloadMerges.note: Added sentinelValues documenting the four legal indexType constants from the 'Index Type' theme.

params.name: aTable
params.description: Table for which to create an index

params.name: fieldsArray
params.description: Pointer(s) to field(s) to be indexed

sentinelValues.meaning: Keywords index: word-by-word indexing (Text/Alpha/Picture fields only); cannot be composite
Default index type: 4D picks the most optimized type (excluding keywords) for the field contents
Cluster B-Tree index: optimized when few distinct keywords occur frequently

params.name: indexName
params.description: Name of the index to create; if it already exists, the command does nothing

overloadMerges.semanticRole: Creates a standard or keyword index on one or more fields of a table, optionally running the indexing asynchronously.
